# Source: Flask

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Flask
- **Artist / culture:** Spring Garden Glass Works American, 1851–1856 Baltimore
- **Date:** 1850–59
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** flask (bottle)
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 50651
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/50651
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/c35df6af-12e6-fa9f-7188-4ca8ebcf2031/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Spring

## Extracted source palette

`#A8A8A8, #D8D8D8, #B8C8B8, #889898, #689888, #587878, #387868, #284848`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#364F47`
- `surface`: `#465953`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#D8D8D8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#284848`
- `surface_variant`: `#4D635C`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#6C7E78`
- `error`: `#D8D8D8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `8.35:1`, surface `7.02:1`
- Variant contrast: `6.07:1`
- Control contrast: `13.71:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
